convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 price functions (iClose, iHigh, iLow) and standard CTrade class. No custom indicators or external trading logic libraries. Simple breakout entry/exit with fixed lot sizing. Time conversion logic is pure math, no MT5-specific API dependency.

derived_values.name: RangeBottom - support level from NY 4H window lowest low
derived_values.formula: min(iLow(M5, i)) for i in range candles during NY 00:00-04:00
derived_values.used_by: long entry breakout condition, long SL

derived_values.name: RangeTop - resistance level from NY 4H window highest high
derived_values.formula: max(iHigh(M5, i)) for i in range candles during NY 00:00-04:00
derived_values.used_by: short entry breakout condition, short SL

derived_values.name: Server UTC offset (hours)
derived_values.formula: ServerGMTOffsetWinter or ServerGMTOffsetSummer based on date vs switch dates

derived_values.name: NY GMT offset (hours)
derived_values.formula: -4 if UTC between DST start and end, else -5

params.long_sl: lowest low of M5 bars[2..15] while below RangeBottom
params.short_sl: highest high of M5 bars[2..15] while above RangeTop

other_exits: SL and TP only - no other exit logic; range reset at next NY session can invalidate range but does not close positions

custom_logic_notes: Breakout strategy based on NY session first 4 hours (00:00-04:00 NY time). Range high/low formed during this window. Entry on M5 close breaking above range bottom (buy) or below range top (sell). SL searched backward up to 15 bars for extreme low/high within the range zone. TP = 2x SL distance. Stops-level check: SL and TP must exceed 4x SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL. DST-aware time conversion: server time -> UTC -> NY time, with separate US DST rules (2nd Sunday March, 1st Sunday November) and configurable server DST switch dates. Range resets each NY day when the 4H window begins again.
python_conversion_notes: Key challenge: DST-aware time conversion from server timezone to NY local time. Must implement ServerToUTC and UTCToNewYork functions with proper DST boundary handling (US 2nd Sunday March / 1st Sunday November rules). The range-forming window is defined in NY local time (00:00-04:00), so accurate timezone conversion is critical. Entry signals use previous 2 M5 bar closes to detect crossover of range boundaries. SL is dynamically searched by scanning backward up to 15 M5 bars for the extreme within the range zone. No indicators used - purely price-based breakout. CTrade wrapper maps to simple market orders. The Stops_Level check (4x broker minimum) must be preserved.
